intro.title: Form Library from Scratch
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple form library from scratch using Vue. You will learn how to create a reusable form component that manages input state and validation. The core concept is reactive state management with Vue's ref and computed properties. You will use Vue components, event handling, and conditional rendering to construct the form. By the end, you'll have a basic library that can handle form data and display validation messages.
intro.usecase: Form libraries are essential in modern web applications where user input drives functionality. You'll find them in e-commerce checkout flows, user registration systems, and admin dashboards where data validation and submission are critical. In Vue applications, custom form libraries power everything from multi-step onboarding wizards to complex data entry panels in enterprise software. Understanding how to build your own form library gives you fine-grained control over validation logic, error handling, and user experience that off-the-shelf solutions might not provide.
